sources.title: Qwen 3.8 27B: Specs, Hardware Requirements, and How to Run It (2026)
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B is out: Apache 2.0, a surprise vision encoder, 262k context, and published benchmarks. The confirmed specs, the GPU memory math, and how to serve it with vLLM or SGLang.

sources.title: How to Run Qwen 3.8 27B on Your Own Computer - lu-labs.ai
sources.snippet: The 2.4 trillion parameter giant opened up on 12 August under Alibaba's own qwen3.8-max licence, and it needs a data center either way. Qwen 3.8 27B followed on 13 August under Apache 2.0, and it is a dense model built to fit on a single graphics card or a decent laptop. This post is about the 27B.

sources.title: Run Qwen3.8-27B Locally: 24GB Mac and GPU Guide (2026)
sources.snippet: Run Qwen3.8-27B Locally: 24GB Mac and GPU Guide (2026) Qwen released Qwen3.8-27B in mid-August 2026, and the community adopted it fast. The unsloth GGUF passed 1,945,635 downloads in about three days (HuggingFace API, 2026). The model is a dense 27B vision-language model under Apache-2.0 with a native 262,144-token context (model card, 2026).
